dependency_resolution.reason: S1 and S2 receipts and contracts must be repository-resolvable before the v0.3 family is frozen.

scientific_scope: A finite prospective search for a source-target ecological relation that predicts dyad-level transferability of post-IBD spatial genetic structure.

completed_predictor_tests_reported_as_pr.label: S3 relational larval host-resource similarity
completed_predictor_tests_reported_as_pr.independence_note: S2 and S3 are not independent species replications; repaired S3 survivors are contained in the S2 survivor set.
completed_predictor_tests_reported_as_pr.repair_note: Current S3 inference uses the response-independent duplicate-header repair: 420 mask survivors, 399 empirical species, 11696 directed dyads.

prospective_family.alpha_method: fixed weighted Bonferroni with equal weights
prospective_family.interpretation: This 0.05 FWER applies to the newly frozen v0.3 prospective family only. The three completed tests are prior evidence, not members whose unused alpha is reclaimed.

retrospective_all_history_label.role: secondary retrospective sensitivity label only; it does not alter the primary v0.3 decision rule
retrospective_all_history_label.if_C_unopened_after_DETECTED_B: Do not report a five-test Holm result. Report the primary v0.3 DETECTED_B decision and the observed historical p-values descriptively; an unopened C slot has no empirical p-value.

conditional_order_contrast_v0_3.reason: same-order and same-family structure is already controlled in Study B; promoting this contrast would create a third confirmatory slot without a distinct primary mechanism.

slot_B.name: environmental niche similarity
slot_B.gate_failure: NOT_EVALUABLE_B; forfeit the B slot and its alpha; proceed to C without replacement or alpha transfer

slot_C.name: historical climate displacement similarity
slot_C.gate_failure: NOT_EVALUABLE_C; forfeit the C slot and its alpha; close the program without replacement

execution_order: Freeze B, C, alpha allocation, freshness rules and stopping states.
Run Study B external-data/geometry and formal synthetic qualification at alpha=0.025.
If B rejects on its one-shot empirical test, close v0.3 as DETECTED_B and do not open C.
If B is a qualified null or NOT_EVALUABLE, proceed to the already frozen C route.
Run C gates and, only if they pass, its one-shot empirical test at alpha=0.025.
Close permanently after C; no fourth ecological predictor is authorized.

terminal_states.DETECTED_B: B rejects at one-sided p<=0.025; ecological predictor detected in v0.3; C remains unopened.
terminal_states.DETECTED_C_AFTER_B_NULL: B is a qualified null and C rejects at p<=0.025; ecological predictor detected in v0.3.
terminal_states.DETECTED_C_AFTER_B_NOT_EVALUABLE: B is NOT_EVALUABLE and C rejects at p<=0.025; ecological predictor detected in the evaluable C slot only.
terminal_states.CLOSED_TWO_NULLS: B and C are both evaluable qualified nulls; the finite two-slot ecological-predictor program is null and no additional predictor search is authorized.
terminal_states.CLOSED_PARTIAL_NOT_EVALUABLE: One slot is a qualified null and the other is NOT_EVALUABLE; search is closed, but this is not a two-null biological conclusion.
terminal_states.CLOSED_NO_EVALUABLE_TEST: Both B and C fail gates; search is closed with no biological null conclusion.

claim_boundary.detection_claim: At least one prospectively frozen v0.3 ecological relation predicts transferability under its licensed domain and controls.
claim_boundary.two_null_claim: Only CLOSED_TWO_NULLS licenses the statement that neither of the two final frozen ecological relations was detected with qualified power.
claim_boundary.partial_gate_failure: NOT_EVALUABLE is never converted into a biological null.
claim_boundary.prior_tests: Completed S1-S3 outcomes remain immutable and cannot be retuned, rerun, or used to choose B/C specifications.
